items.source:
This interface defines the overall context including all known PersistentEntity instances and methods to obtain
instances on demand. it is used internally to establish associations between entities and also at runtime to obtain
entities by name.
items.translation: 该接口定义了整体上下文，包括所有已知的持久实体（PersistentEntity）实例以及按需获取这些实例的方法。它在内部用于建立实体之间的关联，并在运行时通过名称获取实体。

items.source: Value object to access PersistentEntity instances managed by MappingContexts.
items.translation: 用于访问由MappingContext管理的PersistentEntity实例的实体对象。

items.translation: 通用转换框架，用于从数据存储抽象中读取对象并将其写回。
